task:
FIX ONE CODEX REVIEW FINDING ON PR #816 (F2d PR4b). Update only the existing branch f2d/pr4b-probe-publish; its head must be c53247847b6976a4414dfc2dedd735d2e0ffde95 (full SHA from git rev-parse of origin/f2d/pr4b-probe-publish; if it differs, stop and report the SHA you found). Read CLAUDE.md, design section 8.1 "Rollback boundary" in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md, and scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py: select_f2d_rollback (around line 739) and both callers (around lines 2004 and 2067), persist_accepted (around line 1675), the existing first-cutover rollback kinds, and tests/test_v3_release_gate_f2d.py (lines ~283 and ~307 assert compatible_rollback_artifact_not_recorded).

THE FINDING (P1, confirmed): for the FIRST F2d promotion the root-owned receipt store holds only earlier releases that this gate declares schema-incompatible; the compatible candidate manifest exists only in the authenticated operation bundle, and persist_accepted records it only after a successful cutover. No workflow step records a compatible artifact beforehand, so preflight and promote both always refuse with compatible_rollback_artifact_not_recorded: the first F2d release can never be promoted.

THE FIX (owner-approved direction): let the authenticated, checksum-bound CANDIDATE release manifest of this same operation satisfy the compatible-rollback-artifact requirement when no recorded compatible artifact exists, provided the candidate's backend image is in the trimmed rollback target list (at or after minimum_schema_compatible_image) and it validates for purpose="rollback" against the current migration set exactly as recorded artifacts do. Pass the candidate manifest into select_f2d_rollback from both callers (it is already authenticated earlier in those paths; do not re-download or trust anything less authenticated). Prefer a recorded compatible artifact when one exists; fall back to the candidate; record in the preflight/promotion receipt which source satisfied it (recorded_artifact or authenticated_candidate) and its git_sha/backend image. Keep every other refusal unchanged: an incompatible candidate (image before the minimum, or not in the trimmed list) still refuses with compatible_rollback_artifact_not_recorded or f2d_rollback_image_incompatible as today; unsafe/mismatched recorded artifacts still refuse. Update the code comment that currently says "A recorded artifact need not have been deployed..." to describe the real behaviour.

ALLOWED FILES: scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py; tests/test_v3_release_gate_f2d.py; tests/test_v3_production_application_deployment.py only if an existing assertion requires it; docs/operations/v3-production-application-release.md (one or two sentences on the rollback boundary); CHANGES.md (amend the existing PR4b entry, do not add a new one). Nothing else.

TESTS (add, never weaken): first F2d promotion with an empty-of-compatible receipt store and a compatible authenticated candidate passes the rollback requirement and records source authenticated_candidate; a recorded compatible artifact is preferred over the candidate; a candidate whose backend image precedes the minimum (or is absent from the trimmed list) still refuses; a candidate failing validate_manifest(purpose="rollback") still refuses; both callers (preflight and promote paths) pass the candidate. Keep the existing refusal tests meaningful (adjust them to the case with no compatible candidate either).

VALIDATION TO RUN AND REPORT WITH EXACT COUNTS: ruff check scripts tests; python -m pytest tests/test_v3_release_gate_f2d.py tests/test_v3_production_application_deployment.py -q -p no:warnings; python -c that deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json still validates with validate_authority (expect []). Code only; no deploy, no production access. End with: files changed; tests with counts; and anything you could not do.
